name: liminal-keys
description: Liminal Keys plugins for use with Claude: hash signing over MCP with certificates held in Liminal Keys; optional PDF signing skill. Not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

plugins.name: liminal-keys
plugins.description: Request signatures over a digest with any signing certificate held in Liminal Keys, over MCP. Format-agnostic (PAdES, CAdES, XAdES and others). Optional PDF helper with visible stamp. Legal effect depends on your certificate, setup and applicable law.
